review.description: Verification now owns its checkout before mutable preparation and shares authenticated private temporary state through native Make, reconciliation, npm, hosted timing and qualification. Caller graph/defaults, selected sources, exported values and explicit opt-ins remain native; abrupt caller death drains admitted managed work before release. Fixed browser ports remain outside this part.
review.implementation: Inspected isolation.py held flock, process identity and lock-record admission; make_owner.py binds a pidfd guardian and helper leases; verification_run.py preserves selected Makefiles/stdin and creates or proves command sessions; processes.py retains leaders through cleanup and ci.py keeps ownership through manifest timing. Git ceilings compose actual exported caller values; borrowed state restores on exit. The Makefile-only startup .EXTRA_PREREQS is now a private override, so command-line empty/nonempty caller extras still apply to ordinary targets but cannot remove admission. Checker invocations share independent subreaper supervision; they stop exact Make on timeout, allow guardian drain, reap remaining owned descendants and require acknowledgement before deleting their fixture. Checker TestCase method dispatch now runs in a child beneath the independent subreaper while the parent retains fixture ownership. This covers direct Make and interactive stdin calls as well as the ordinary helper; parent deletion follows the whole-method drain acknowledgement. Child-side early capture-directory deletion is removed.
review.tests: Inspected the actual native graph, process identity, cancellation, owner-token and Git-ceiling assertions. Extended caller extra-prerequisite controls cover command-line empty/nonempty values under serial, parallel and keep-going flags. The contended fake-provider control checks bin never appears; its old-hook negative control creates bin before rejection. The real checker timeout control observes cooperative helper cleanup, guardian/worker disappearance, removed private state and an unrelated surviving child before fixture deletion. Existing supervisor interruption, nonzero and missing-ack controls still apply. Complete declared fixture suites are required for these refreshed inputs; no real-host coverage is inferred. A real direct Make timeout inside a checker-method worker exercises the formerly bypassing route: the test failure reaches its parent only after cooperative helper cleanup and guardian/worker reaping; the fixture still exists for inspection and an unrelated child survives. Focused native Git-ceiling and interactive stdin cases also pass through that method boundary.
